reason: A DeepSeek Harness plugin focused on improving the chat command interface with completion, parameter guidance, command popups, session operation menus, and empty-conversation command rendering fixes.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 聊天命令输入提供补全、参数提示、候选弹框、会话操作菜单和空对话命令渲染修复。
summaries.en: Improves DeepSeek Harness command entry with completion, parameter hints, candidate popups, session operation menus, and empty-conversation rendering fixes.

capabilities: Adds Tab/Enter command-name completion in the chat composer
Displays command parameter hints and candidate popups
Patches command availability and operation menus in tool-enabled sessions
Fixes command rendering and session handling for empty conversations
Caches and invalidates the local command catalog
